name: Atami (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Atami city emblem in white: an outlined plum blossom enclosing a stylised hot-spring symbol.
history: Municipal flag of Atami, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 10 April 1937.

features.role: Atami city emblem — an outlined plum blossom enclosing a stylised hot-spring symbol
